subject: Traffic surge — temporary quota & rate-limit request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@nimbus-retail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@nimbus-retail.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Traffic spike — temporary quota increase needed

Sergio,

TL;DR — marketing launched an unplanned campaign and we're getting throttled. We need a temporary token quota bump and higher rate limits for 72 hours starting 2026-05-10 00:00 UTC. Please advise pricing and any paperwork so we can flip the switch.

Details: we ran a targeted email + push + on-site flow that tripled our baseline inference traffic overnight. Customer-facing endpoints are returning 429s and our ops team is seeing elevated latency. Attached is a short dump of today's calls and token usage.

What we need:
- Increase daily token quota from 2,000,000 -> 5,000,000 for 72 hours (May 10–12)
- Raise rate limit per-route from 30 rps -> 120 rps for the same window
- Clear pricing for burst credits or one-off true-up (we can pay post-event)

We understand this is a last-minute ask; we just need confirmation and numbers so we can decide by EOD. If there's a quicker path than a formal addendum, let us know.

Attachment: usage_report_May.csv

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
VP Product Operations | Nimbus Retail
jordan.blake@nimbus-retail.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@nimbus-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Traffic spike — temporary quota increase needed

Jordan — thanks for the heads up and the report. We can support this spike; here are two practical options we can turn on quickly (I copied CS and Finance for approval/visibility):

Option A — Emergency burst (fastest, no commit):
- Additive burst credit pricing at list $0.006 / token for overrun usage during the window.
- I can offer a 20% emergency discount if you agree to a capped spend of $25k for the event (pre-approval required).
- No rate-limit change required, but we'll provision additional capacity behind the scenes.

Option B — Short-term rate upgrade + true-up (recommended for latency-sensitive flows):
- Temporary rate-limit increase to 120 rps for 72 hours for a flat fee of $3,000 (one-time).
- Any token overrun billed as a true-up at $0.005 / token (we can offer a 35% discount off list up to a $20k cap if you sign a short addendum).

Operational notes: we can stand up the rate-limit change within 2–4 hours after we get internal approvals and a signed addendum or email confirmation, whichever you prefer. Billing would flow as a one-time true-up on your next invoice with line-item detail.

I'll push this to Marissa and Rishi for a quick internal ok on the discounts/caps. If you want the fastest path, reply here with the preferred option and a hard start time — we will queue the change.

Attached: proposed_burst_quote.pdf (draft)

— Sergio
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 May 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Traffic spike — temporary quota increase needed (internal)

Sergio — seeing this now. My recommendation: approve Option B with the following guardrails so we don't set a bad precedent:

1) Discounting & cap:
- Approve 35% off list for token true-up pricing, only up to $20k of overage. Beyond $20k will be billed at list true-up rate (no additional discount).
2) Rate-limit upgrade:
- Approve the flat $3,000 fee to raise to 120 rps for 72 hours.
3) Contractual requirement:
- Require a signed short addendum (1 page) that acknowledges this is a temporary upgrade and that billing will occur as a one-off true-up on the next monthly invoice. We can sign via DocuSign; I'll attach the stub.
4) Ops/Support:
- CS to monitor the window and we will enable automatic fallback to their pinned model variant if we see degradation.

If Rishi signs off on the $20k cap and Monica confirms we can push rate-limit changes this weekend, I approve Sergio to go live and confirm with Jordan.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: URGENT: Traffic spike — temporary quota increase needed

Jordan — quick update and confirmation. Internal approvals came through: we will proceed with Option B (rate upgrade + true-up) under the terms below.

Confirmed terms (approved):
- Rate-limit upgrade: 30 rps -> 120 rps, window: 2026-05-10 00:00 UTC -> 2026-05-13 00:00 UTC (72 hours)
- One-time rate upgrade fee: $3,000 (billed on next invoice)
- Overage true-up pricing: $0.005 / token with a 35% discount applied up to a $20,000 overage cap (effective true-up price for first $20k of overage = $0.00325 / token equivalent)
- Billing: one single true-up line item on your next invoice; any overage beyond the cap billed thereafter at list rate.
- Contract: we require a signed 1-page addendum; DocuSign link below. Service will be provisioned once we have a signed addendum or explicit email approval to proceed immediately.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/0A1B2C3D4E5F
Redwood deal: https://app.redwood.com/deals/DEAL-7890

Next steps for you:
1) Reply with confirmation of Option B and acceptance of the $20k cap (or propose a different cap).
2) Sign the DocuSign addendum (or say "email approval ok").
3) We'll schedule the configuration change to begin at your requested start.

If you want us to provision now under email approval, reply here and we will queue the change immediately.

— Sergio
